PowerPoint Presentation (.pptx)

Generates a formal Microsoft PowerPoint slide deck. Each on-click step is captured as a slide with high-resolution map graphics, permanent labels, highlighted routes, and presenter notes.

  • • Standard 16:9 widescreen presentation deck
  • • Step-by-step progressive animation reveal
  • • Formal callout annotations & slide notes

Video File for PPT (WebM / MP4)

Record the smooth path drawing directly into a video. Insert into your PowerPoint slide (Insert > Video) with playback set to "Play on Click".

  • • Smooth path drawing & travel progression
  • • Ready for PowerPoint native video player

Standalone Presentation (HTML)

Self-contained offline presentation file. Open in any browser during board meetings or client presentations.

  • • Interactive on-click navigation
  • • Operates 100% offline without dependencies
